translations.idiomatic: With scarcely a company at first, you destroyed the palace demons, steadied the altars in peril, and rescued the lineage from ruin.

sentences.zh: 此陛下孝悌之至，通於神明，光於四海，無所不通。

translations.literal: This is Your Majesty's utmost filial piety and brotherliness, penetrating to the spirits, shining over the four seas—nothing is not penetrated.
translations.idiomatic: This is Your Majesty's utmost filial piety and brotherliness, penetrating the spirits and shining over the four seas.

sentences.zh: 使諸侯得守其法度，卿大夫得盡其言行，士得資親以事君，庶人得用天而分地。

translations.literal: You cause feudal lords to keep their laws and measures, grandees to exhaust their words and conduct, shi to support kin in serving the lord, commoners to use Heaven and divide the land.
translations.idiomatic: You let lords keep their laws, grandees fulfill their conduct, shi support kin in serving the throne, and commoners work Heaven's land.

sentences.zh: 此陛下無體之禮，以安上理人也。

translations.literal: This is Your Majesty's formless ritual—to settle those above and govern people.
translations.idiomatic: This is Your Majesty's formless ritual—settling superiors and governing the people.

sentences.zh: 上元以來，政由武氏，文明之後，法在凶人。

translations.literal: From the Shangyuan era onward, government lay with the Wu clan; after Wenming, law lay with vicious men.
translations.idiomatic: From Shangyuan onward the Wu clan held power; after Wenming, law served vicious men.

sentences.zh: 賊害宗親，誅滅良善，勳階歲累，酺赦年頻。

translations.literal: They harmed and killed the lineage kin, executed and extinguished the good, ranks of merit piled year by year, amnesty feasts came year by year.
translations.idiomatic: They harmed kin, killed the good, heaped merit ranks yearly, and granted amnesties yearly.

sentences.zh: 佞之則榮華，正之則遷謫。

translations.literal: If one flattered them, glory; if one was upright, demotion and exile.
translations.idiomatic: Flatterers flourished; the upright were exiled.

sentences.zh: 神龍、景雲之際，其事尤繁；

translations.literal: At the Shenlong and Jingyun junctures, such matters were especially numerous;
translations.idiomatic: Under Shenlong and Jingyun such abuses were especially many;

sentences.zh: 先天、開元之間，斯弊都革。

translations.literal: between the Xiantian and Kaiyuan periods, these abuses were all reformed.
translations.idiomatic: from Xiantian through Kaiyuan those abuses were all reformed.

sentences.zh: 此陛下之無聲之樂，以移風易俗也。

translations.literal: This is Your Majesty's soundless music—to shift custom and change the vulgar.
translations.idiomatic: This is Your Majesty's soundless music—shifting custom and changing the vulgar.

sentences.zh: 臣前狀單略，議者未識臣之懇誠。

translations.literal: Your servant's earlier memorial was brief; deliberators did not recognize your servant's earnest sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: My earlier memorial was brief; debaters did not see my earnest sincerity.

sentences.zh: 謹具狀重進，請付中書門下商量處分。

translations.literal: Respectfully we present the full memorial again and ask that it be sent to the Secretariat and Chancellery for deliberation and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully submit the full memorial again and ask the Secretariat and Chancellery to deliberate and decide.

sentences.zh: 臣言若讜，然敢側足於軒墀；

translations.literal: If your servant's words are loyal, I still dare set foot on the palace steps;
translations.idiomatic: If my words are loyal, I still dare stand on the palace steps;

sentences.zh: 臣言不忠，伏請竄跡於荒裔。

translations.literal: if your servant's words are disloyal, I prostrate myself and ask to be banished to the wild border.
translations.idiomatic: if they are disloyal, I ask to be banished to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 左散騎常侍元行沖奏議曰：「天地之性，惟人最靈者，蓋以智周萬物，惟睿作聖，明貴賤，辨尊卑，遠嫌疑，分情理也。

translations.literal: Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Yuan Xingchong submitted a deliberation, saying: "Of Heaven and Earth's nature, only the human is most spiritual—because wisdom encompasses the ten thousand things, only the perspicacious become sage, discerning noble and base, distinguishing honored and humble, keeping distant what is suspect, dividing feeling and principle."
translations.idiomatic: Left Cavalry Regular Attendant Yuan Xingchong argued: among Heaven and Earth's creatures only humans are most spirit-filled—wisdom spans the ten thousand things, the perspicacious become sages, they sort noble and base, honored and humble, keep distance from suspicion, and divide feeling from principle.

sentences.zh: 是以古之聖人，征性識本，緣情制服，有申有厭。

translations.literal: Therefore the ancient sages examined nature to know the root, followed feeling to set garments—there is extension and there is reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient sages read nature for the root and followed feeling to set garments—sometimes extending, sometimes reducing.

sentences.zh: 天父、天夫，故斬衰三年，情理俱盡者，因心立極也。

translations.literal: Heaven as father, Heaven as husband—therefore full sackcloth three years; where feeling and principle are both exhausted, the heart establishes the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven is father, Heaven is husband—hence three years' full sackcloth where feeling and principle are both spent, the heart sets the utmost limit.

sentences.zh: 生則齊體，死則同穴，比陰陽而配合，同兩儀而成化。

translations.literal: In life they share one body; in death one grave—matching yin and yang in union, forming transformation with the two principles.
translations.idiomatic: Alive they share one body; dead one grave—yin and yang paired, the two principles made whole.

sentences.zh: 而妻喪杖期，情禮俱殺者，蓋以遠嫌疑，尊乾道也。

translations.literal: Yet for a wife's mourning, staff for one year—where feeling and ritual are both reduced—is because one keeps distant what is suspect and honors the yang way.
translations.idiomatic: Yet a wife's death brings staff for one year—feeling and ritual both cut—to keep distance from suspicion and honor the yang way.

sentences.zh: 父為嫡子三年斬衰，而不去職者，蓋尊祖重嫡，崇禮殺情也。

translations.literal: A father for the legitimate son wears three years' full sackcloth yet does not leave office—because one honors the grandfather and values the legitimate line, exalting ritual and reducing feeling.
translations.idiomatic: A father for a legitimate son wears three years' sackcloth yet keeps office—honoring the grandfather and the main line, exalting ritual over feeling.

sentences.zh: 資於事父以事君，孝莫大於嚴父。

translations.literal: Taking from serving the father to serve the lord—filial piety is not greater than honoring the father.
translations.idiomatic: Serving the lord by the measure of serving the father—filial piety is greatest in honoring the father.

sentences.zh: 故父在，為母罷職齊周而心喪三年，謂之尊厭者，則情申而禮殺也。

translations.literal: Therefore when the father is alive, for the mother one leaves office for qi for one cycle and heart mourning three years—called honored reduction: then feeling is extended but ritual reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Hence while the father lives, for the mother one leaves office for one qi cycle with three years' heart mourning—honored reduction: feeling extended, ritual reduced.

sentences.zh: 斯制也，可以異於飛走，別於華夷。

translations.literal: This regulation can distinguish from birds and beasts and set apart from Chinese and barbarian.
translations.idiomatic: This rule separates humans from beasts and Chinese from barbarians.

sentences.zh: 羲、農、堯、舜，莫之易也；

translations.literal: Xi, Nong, Yao, and Shun—none changed it;
translations.idiomatic: Xi, Nong, Yao, and Shun changed none of it;

sentences.zh: 文、武、周、孔，同所尊也。

translations.literal: Wen, Wu, Zhou, and Confucius alike honored it.
translations.idiomatic: Wen, Wu, the Zhou, and Confucius honored the same thing.

sentences.zh: 今若舍尊厭之重，虧嚴父之義，略純素之嫌，貽非聖之責，則事不師古，有傷名教矣。

translations.literal: Now if we abandon the weight of honored reduction, injure the meaning of honoring the father, slight the suspicion of plain simplicity, and leave a charge of being non-sage—then affairs do not take the ancients as teachers and famous teaching is harmed.
translations.idiomatic: To abandon honored reduction, injure honoring the father, slight plain simplicity, and invite a charge of opposing the sages is to reject the ancients and harm teaching.

sentences.zh: 姨兼從母之名，即母之女黨，加於舅服，有理存焉。

translations.literal: Aunt shares the name of mother's sister—she is the mother's female kin; to add to the uncle's mourning has reason in it.
translations.idiomatic: An aunt shares the mother's sister's title—mother's female kin; increasing the uncle's mourning has its reason.

sentences.zh: 嫂叔不服，避嫌疑也。

translations.literal: Sister-in-law and brother-in-law do not wear mourning—avoiding suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: Sister-in-law and brother-in-law wear no mourning—to avoid suspicion.

sentences.zh: 若引同爨之緦，以忘推遠之跡，既乖前聖，亦謂難從。

translations.literal: If one cites the si hemp of sharing the hearth to forget the trace of pushing distant, it both departs from former sages and is also said hard to follow.
translations.idiomatic: To cite shared-hearth si hemp and forget the rule of pushing the distant both departs from the sages and is hard to follow.

sentences.zh: 謹詳三者之疑，並請依古為當。

translations.literal: Respectfully examining the three doubts, we together ask to follow antiquity as correct.
translations.idiomatic: On all three doubts, we ask that antiquity be followed.

sentences.zh: 」自是百僚議意不決。

translations.literal: " From this the hundred officials' deliberations did not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the hundred officials could not settle the debate.

sentences.zh: 至七年八月，下敕曰：「惟周公制禮，當歷代不刊；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year, an edict was issued: "Only the Duke of Zhou fashioned ritual—it should endure through generations without revision;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year seven an edict said: "Only the Duke of Zhou made ritual, fit to endure through the ages;

sentences.zh: 況子夏為《傳》，乃孔門所受。

translations.literal: how much more when Zixia wrote the Commentary—it was what the Confucian gate received."
translations.idiomatic: how much more Zixia's Commentary, received from Confucius's school."

sentences.zh: 格條之內，有父在為母齊衰三年，此有為而為，非尊厭之義。

translations.literal: Within the statute articles is "while the father lives, for the mother qi sackcloth three years"—this was purposeful action, not the meaning of honored reduction.
translations.idiomatic: The statutes include "while the father lives, qi sackcloth three years for the mother"—a purposeful rule, not honored reduction.

sentences.zh: 與其改作，不如師古，諸服紀宜一依《喪服》文。

translations.literal: Rather than revise, better to take the ancients as teachers—all mourning regulations should uniformly follow the Mourning Dress text.
translations.idiomatic: Rather than revise, follow the ancients: all mourning grades should follow the Mourning Dress text.

sentences.zh: 」自是卿士之家，父在為母行服不同：或既周而禫，禫服六十日釋服，心喪三年者；

translations.literal: " From this in the homes of ministers and grandees, mourning while the father lived for the mother differed: some, having completed the cycle, performed the capping rite, released the dress after sixty days of capping dress, with three years' heart mourning;
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter in noble households practice diverged: some finished the cycle, capped, released dress after sixty days, yet kept three years' heart mourning;

sentences.zh: 或有既周而禫服終三年者；

translations.literal: some had completed the cycle and the capping dress ran the full three years.
translations.idiomatic: others kept capping dress the full three years.

sentences.zh: 或有依上元之制，齊衰三年者。

translations.literal: Some followed the Shangyuan regulation of qi sackcloth for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Some still followed the Shangyuan rule of three years' qi sackcloth for the mother.

sentences.zh: 時議者是非紛然，元行沖謂人曰：「聖人制厭降之禮，豈不知母恩之深也，以尊祖貴祢，欲其遠別禽獸，近異夷狄故也。

translations.literal: At the time deliberators were divided in approval and blame; Yuan Xingchong said to people: "The sage fashioned the ritual of honored reduction—how could he not know the mother's favor is deep? It is to honor the grandfather and value the father, wishing men far to separate from beasts and near to differ from barbarians."
translations.idiomatic: Debate was fierce; Yuan Xingchong said: "The sage made honored-reduction mourning knowing the mother's debt is deep—yet he honored grandfather and father so men would stand far from beasts and near from barbarians."

sentences.zh: 人情易搖，淺識者眾。

translations.literal: Human feeling is easy to shake; shallow understanding is common.
translations.idiomatic: Feeling shifts easily; shallow views are many.

sentences.zh: 一紊其度，其可止乎！

translations.literal: Once one confuses the measure, can it be stopped!
translations.idiomatic: Once the measure is confused, how can it be stopped!

sentences.zh: 」二十年，中書令蕭嵩與學士改修定五禮，又議請依上元敕，父在為母齊衰三年為定。

translations.literal: " In the twentieth year, Secretariat Director Xiao Song and academicians revised and fixed the Five Rites; they again deliberated and asked to take the Shangyuan edict—while the father lives, qi sackcloth three years for the mother—as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty, Xiao Song and the academicians revised the Five Rites and again asked to fix Shangyuan's rule: three years' qi for the mother while the father lives.

sentences.zh: 及頒禮，乃一依行焉。

translations.literal: When the rites were promulgated, all uniformly followed them.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were issued, all followed them uniformly.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，藉田禮畢，正制曰：「服制之紀，或有所未通，宜令禮官學士詳議聞奏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, when the plowing rite was completed, a formal regulation said: "In the canon of mourning dress, some points may not be fully clear; ritual officials and scholars should deliberate in detail and report."
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-three, after the plowing rite, a regulation said: "Some mourning rules remain unclear; let ritual officers and scholars debate and report."

sentences.zh: 」太常卿韋縚奏曰：「謹按《儀禮喪服》：舅，緦麻三月。

translations.literal: " Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wei Tao memorialized: "Respectfully according to the Mourning Dress in the Ceremonies: maternal uncle, finest hemp three months."
translations.idiomatic: Director Wei Tao wrote: "Per the Ceremonial Mourning Dress: a maternal uncle wears finest hemp for three months."

sentences.zh: 從母，小功五月。

translations.literal: Mother's sister, lesser merit five months.
translations.idiomatic: A mother's sister: lesser merit five months.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：可以小功，以名加也。

translations.literal: The Commentary says: may use lesser merit, by name increased.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary: lesser merit is permitted—added by name.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅、舅母，恩所不及。

translations.literal: Hall aunt and uncle, uncle's wife—favor does not reach.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins and an uncle's wife lie outside the reach of favor.

sentences.zh: 外祖父母。

translations.literal: Maternal grandparents.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents:

sentences.zh: 小功五月。

translations.literal: lesser merit five months.
translations.idiomatic: They wear lesser merit for five months.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：何以小功，以尊加也。

translations.literal: The Commentary says: why lesser merit? By honored rank increased.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary: why lesser merit? Honor adds a grade.

sentences.zh: 舅，緦麻三月，並是情親而服屬疏者也。

translations.literal: Uncle, finest hemp three months—all are close in feeling but distant in kin category.
translations.idiomatic: Uncle, finest hemp three months—all close in feeling, distant in kinship.

sentences.zh: 外祖正尊，同於從母之服。

translations.literal: Maternal grandfather as true honored rank, same mourning as mother's sister.
translations.idiomatic: A maternal grandfather as true senior matches the mother's sister's grade.

sentences.zh: 姨舅一等，服則輕重有殊。

translations.literal: Aunt and uncle are one class; mourning then differs in weight.
translations.idiomatic: Aunts and uncles are one class, yet grades differ in weight.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅親即未疏，恩絕不相為服。

translations.literal: Hall aunt and uncle: kin is not yet distant, yet favor is cut off and they do not wear mourning for one another.
translations.idiomatic: Hall aunt and uncle: kin is not distant, yet favor is severed and no mourning is worn.

sentences.zh: 親舅母來承外族，同爨之禮不加。

translations.literal: A close uncle's wife comes to carry the external lineage; the ritual of sharing the hearth is not added.
translations.idiomatic: A close uncle's wife joins the external line; shared-hearth ritual is not added.

sentences.zh: 竊以古意猶有所未暢者也。

translations.literal: We venture that ancient intent still has what is not fully expressed.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient intent, we think, is not yet fully expressed.

sentences.zh: 且為外祖小功，此則正尊情甚親而服屬疏者也，請加至大功九月。

translations.literal: Moreover for maternal grandparents in lesser merit—this is true honored rank, very close in feeling yet distant in kin category—we ask to increase to great merit nine months.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents at lesser merit are true seniors, close in feeling yet distant in kin—we ask great merit for nine months.

sentences.zh: 姨舅儕類，親既無別，服宜齊等，請為舅加至小功五月。

translations.literal: Aunt and uncle are peers; kin is already without distinction—mourning should be equal; we ask for the uncle to be increased to lesser merit five months.
translations.idiomatic: Aunts and uncles are peers without kin distinction—mourning should be equal; we ask five months' lesser merit for the uncle.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅疏降一等，親舅母從服之例，先無制服之文，並望加至袒免。

translations.literal: Hall aunt and uncle reduced one grade; close uncle's wife follows mourning—the precedent had no fixed mourning text; all hope to be increased to tan mian.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins drop one grade; a close uncle's wife follows mourning without prior fixed text—we ask tan mian for all.

sentences.zh: 臣聞禮以飾情，服從義制，或有沿革，損益可明。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that ritual adorns feeling and mourning follows righteous regulation; there may be continuations and changes, and what is to be reduced or increased can be made clear.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that ritual adorns emotion and mourning dress follows moral rule—where practice has shifted, what to add or trim can be stated plainly.

sentences.zh: 事體既大，理資詳審。

translations.literal: The matter in its substance is already great; reason requires thorough deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter is weighty and calls for careful deliberation.

sentences.zh: 望付尚書省集眾官吏詳議，務從折衷，永為典則。」

translations.literal: We hope it may be entrusted to the Department of State Affairs to assemble the multitude of officials for detailed discussion, striving for compromise, and made a perpetual standard."
translations.idiomatic: Please refer it to the Department of State Affairs for a full council of officials, seek a balanced outcome, and fix it as a lasting rule.

sentences.zh: 於是太子賓客崔沔建議曰：「竊聞大道既隱，天下為家。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Mentor of the Heir Apparent Cui Mian submitted a recommendation, saying: "Your servant has heard that when the Great Way was concealed, all under Heaven became one's household.
translations.idiomatic: Then Mentor of the Heir Apparent Cui Mian memorialized: "I have heard that once the Great Way was hidden, the realm became a single household.

sentences.zh: 聖人因之，然後製禮。

translations.literal: The sages followed this and thereafter fashioned rites.
translations.idiomatic: The sages took that as their basis and then fashioned ritual.

sentences.zh: 禮教之設，本為正家，家道正而天下定矣。

translations.literal: The establishment of ritual teaching was fundamentally to rectify the family; when the family way is rectified, all under Heaven is settled.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual teaching was instituted chiefly to set the household in order; when the household is right, the realm is stable.

sentences.zh: 正家之道，不可以貳，總一定議，理歸本宗。

translations.literal: The way to rectify the family cannot be twofold; to gather and fix one deliberation, reason returns to the root lineage.
translations.idiomatic: The way to order a household cannot be divided in two: one settled rule, with principle anchored in the main line.

sentences.zh: 父以尊崇，母以厭降，豈忘愛敬，宜存倫序。

translations.literal: The father is honored and elevated; the mother is suppressed and demoted—how could one forget love and respect? One should preserve the order of human relations.
translations.idiomatic: The father is exalted and the mother reduced in rank—not to forget love and respect, but to keep relational order.

sentences.zh: 是以內有齊斬，外服皆緦麻，尊名所加，不過一等，此先王不易之道也。

translations.literal: Therefore within there is zhan and cui; for external relations all wear si hemp; where honored names are added, it does not exceed one grade—this is the unchanging way of the former kings.
translations.idiomatic: Hence within the family are the heaviest grades of mourning; for outside kin all wear the lightest hemp; added honor never exceeds one step—this is the former kings' unchanging rule.

sentences.zh: 前聖所志，後賢所傳，其來久矣。

translations.literal: What former sages recorded, later worthies transmitted—the coming of it is long.
translations.idiomatic: Former sages recorded it, later worthies transmitted it—long established.

sentences.zh: 昔辛有適伊川，見被髮而祭於野者，曰：『不及百年，此其戎乎？

translations.literal: Formerly Xin You, going to Yichuan, saw one with disheveled hair sacrificing in the wild and said: "Within a hundred years, will this not be the Rong?
translations.idiomatic: Once Xin You, passing Yichuan, saw disheveled hair sacrificing in the wild and said: "Within a hundred years will this not be the Rong?

sentences.zh: 其禮先亡矣」！

translations.literal: Their ritual is already lost!"
translations.idiomatic: Their ritual will perish first!"

sentences.zh: 貞觀修禮，時改舊章，漸廣渭陽之恩，不遵洙、泗之典。

translations.literal: In Zhenguan ritual was revised and the old statutes changed; gradually the favor of the Wei-yang kin was broadened, not following the canon of Zhu and Si.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenguan ritual revision widened Wei-yang kin favor and abandoned the Zhu-Si canon.

sentences.zh: 及弘道之後，唐隆之間，國命再移於外族矣。

translations.literal: After the Hongdao era, in the Tanglong interval, the state mandate twice shifted to external kin.
translations.idiomatic: After Hongdao, in the Tanglong years, the mandate twice passed to outsiders.

sentences.zh: 禮亡徵兆，儻或斯見，天人之際，可不誡哉！

translations.literal: The omen of ritual's loss—perhaps this is seen; between Heaven and man—can one not be warned!
translations.idiomatic: The omen of ritual's loss may already show; between Heaven and man—can we not be warned!

sentences.zh: 開元初，補闕盧履冰嘗進狀論喪服輕重，敕令僉議。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan, Remonstrator Lu Lübing once submitted a memorial discussing the weight of mourning dress; an edict ordered collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Early Kaiyuan, Remonstrator Lu Lübing memorialized on mourning grades; the throne ordered collective debate.

sentences.zh: 於時群議紛拏，各安積習，太常禮部，奏依舊定。

translations.literal: At the time group deliberation was clamorous; each clung to accumulated practice; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ministry of Rites memorialized to follow the old fix.
translations.idiomatic: Debate was noisy; each clung to habit; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ministry of Rites asked to keep the old rule.

sentences.zh: 陛下運稽古之思，發獨斷之明，至開元八年，特降別敕，一依古禮。

translations.literal: Your Majesty exercised thought of examining antiquity and issued the clarity of independent decision; by the eighth year of Kaiyuan a special edict was specially sent down, uniformly following ancient ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty studied antiquity and ruled alone; in Kaiyuan eight a special edict restored ancient ritual throughout.

sentences.zh: 事符故實，人知向方，式固宗盟，社稷之福。

translations.literal: The matter matched old fact; men knew the direction; thereby the lineage bond was secured—the blessing of the altars.
translations.idiomatic: It matched precedent, men knew the direction, the lineage was secured—the altars' blessing.

sentences.zh: 更圖異議，竊所未詳。

translations.literal: To again plot a different deliberation—your servant has not understood.
translations.idiomatic: To reopen debate—I do not understand why.

sentences.zh: 願守八年明旨，以為萬代成法。」

translations.literal: We wish to keep the clear intent of the eighth year as the perpetual law for ten thousand generations."
translations.idiomatic: Keep the eighth-year mandate as the law for ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 職方郎中韋述議曰：

translations.literal: Director in the Bureau of Appointments Wei Shu deliberated:
translations.idiomatic: Director Wei Shu argued:

sentences.zh: 天生萬物，惟人最靈。

translations.literal: Heaven gives birth to the ten thousand things; only the human is most spiritual.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven births the ten thousand things; only humans are most spirit-filled.

sentences.zh: 所以尊尊親親，別生分類，存則盡其愛敬，沒則盡其哀戚。

translations.literal: Therefore to honor the honored and be intimate with the intimate, distinguish birth and classify kin; while alive exhaust love and respect, when dead exhaust grief.
translations.idiomatic: Hence honor the honored, cherish the intimate, sort kin by birth; alive exhaust love and respect, dead exhaust grief.

sentences.zh: 緣情而制服，考事而立言，往聖討論，亦已勤矣。

translations.literal: Following feeling to set garments, examining affairs to establish words—former sages discussed, already diligently.
translations.idiomatic: Garments follow feeling, words follow facts—former sages labored at this.

sentences.zh: 上自高祖，下至玄孫，以及其身，謂之九族。

translations.literal: From High Ancestor down to great-great-grandson, including oneself—this is called the nine kin groups.
translations.idiomatic: From great-great-grandfather down through oneself—nine kin groups.

sentences.zh: 由近而及遠，稱情而立文，差其輕重，遂為五服。

translations.literal: From near reaching far, naming feeling to establish text, adjusting their weight and light—thereby the five garments.
translations.idiomatic: From near to far, naming feeling to set text, adjusting weight—there are five garments.

sentences.zh: 雖則或以義降，或以名加，教有所從，理不逾等。

translations.literal: Although sometimes by righteousness reduced, sometimes by name increased, teaching has what it follows; principle does not exceed grades.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes reduced by righteousness, sometimes raised by name—teaching has its source; principle does not leap grades.

sentences.zh: 百王不易，三代可知，日月同懸，咸所仰也。

translations.literal: The hundred kings do not change it; the three dynasties can be known; sun and moon hang together—all look up to it.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred kings do not change it; three dynasties prove it; sun and moon alike—all look up.

sentences.zh: 自微言既絕，大義復乖，雖文質有遷，而必遵此制。

translations.literal: Since subtle words were cut off, the great meaning again diverged; though pattern and substance shifted, one must follow this regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Since subtle words ceased, great meaning diverged; though form shifted, this regulation must be kept.

sentences.zh: 謹按《儀禮·喪服傳》曰：「外親之服皆緦麻。

translations.literal: Respectfully according to the Mourning Dress Commentary in the Ceremonies: "All mourning for external kin is finest hemp."
translations.idiomatic: Per the Ceremonial Mourning Dress Commentary: "All external kin wear finest hemp."

sentences.zh: 」鄭玄謂：「外親，異姓。

translations.literal: " Zheng Xuan says: "External kin—different surnames."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan: "External kin are different surnames."

sentences.zh: 正服不過緦麻。

translations.literal: Proper mourning does not exceed finest hemp."
translations.idiomatic: Formal mourning for them never exceeds finest hemp."

sentences.zh: 」外祖父母，小功五月，以尊加也。

translations.literal: " Maternal grandparents, lesser merit five months, by honored rank increased.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents: lesser merit five months, honor adds a grade.

sentences.zh: 從母，小功五月，以名加也。

translations.literal: Mother's sister, lesser merit five months, by name increased.
translations.idiomatic: Mother's sister: lesser merit five months, name adds a grade.

sentences.zh: 舅甥外孫、中外昆弟，依本服緦麻三月。

translations.literal: Uncle, nephew on mother's side, grandson on mother's side, kin brothers Chinese and foreign—according to their root garment, finest hemp three months.
translations.idiomatic: Uncle, sister's son, daughter's son, mixed kin brothers—root garment finest hemp three months.

sentences.zh: 若以匹敵，外祖則祖也，舅則伯叔父之別也。

translations.literal: If matched as peers, the maternal grandfather is grandfather; the uncle is the category of paternal uncles.
translations.idiomatic: As peers, a maternal grandfather is a grandfather; an uncle matches paternal uncles.

sentences.zh: 姨舅伯叔，則父母之恩不殊，而獨殺於外氏，聖人之心，良有以也。

translations.literal: Aunt, uncle, and paternal uncles—then the parents' favor is not different, yet alone reduced for the external lineage—the sage's heart truly has its reason.
translations.idiomatic: Aunts, uncles, and paternal uncles share parental favor, yet external kin alone are reduced—the sage had reason.

sentences.zh: 《喪服傳》曰：「禽獸知母而不知父。

translations.literal: The Mourning Dress Commentary says: "Beasts know the mother and do not know the father."
translations.idiomatic: The Mourning Dress Commentary: "Beasts know mother, not father."

sentences.zh: 」野人曰，父母何算焉。

translations.literal: " The wild man says: what calculation for father and mother?
translations.idiomatic: Wild men ask: what reckoning for father and mother?

sentences.zh: 都邑之士，則知尊祢矣。

translations.literal: The man of the capital district then knows to honor the father.
translations.idiomatic: Townsmen then know to honor the father.

sentences.zh: 大夫及學士，則知尊祖也。

translations.literal: The great officer and scholar then know to honor the grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Great officers and scholars know to honor the grandfather.

sentences.zh: 諸侯及其太祖，天子及其始祖。

translations.literal: The feudal lord and his great ancestor; the Son of Heaven and his founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Lords honor their great ancestor; the Son of Heaven his founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 聖人究天道而厚於祖祢，系姓族而親其子孫，近則別其賢愚，遠則異於禽獸。

translations.literal: The sage exhausts Heaven's way and is thick toward grandfather and father, ties surname clans and is intimate with sons and grandsons; near then distinguishes worthy and unworthy, far then differs from birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: The sage exhausts Heaven's way, thickens toward ancestors, ties clans and cherishes descendants; near he sorts worthy and unworthy, far he parts from beasts.

sentences.zh: 由此言之，母黨比於本族，不可同貫明矣。

translations.literal: From this to speak, the mother's kin compared with the root clan cannot be threaded on one string—clear.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the mother's kin cannot be strung with the root clan on one thread—clearly so.

sentences.zh: 且家無二尊，喪無二斬，人之所奉，不可貳也。

translations.literal: Moreover the family has no two elders; mourning has no two zhan—what men serve cannot be twofold.
translations.idiomatic: A household has no two elders; mourning has no two zhan—what one serves cannot be doubled.

sentences.zh: 特重於大宗者，降其小宗；

translations.literal: Where especially heavy on the great lineage, reduce the lesser lineage;
translations.idiomatic: Where the great lineage is especially heavy, the lesser is reduced;

sentences.zh: 為人後者，減其父母之服；

translations.literal: one who becomes a successor reduces mourning for his parents;
translations.idiomatic: an heir reduces mourning for parents;

sentences.zh: 女子出嫁，殺其本家之喪。

translations.literal: a woman marrying out reduces mourning for her root family.
translations.idiomatic: a woman marrying out reduces mourning for her birth family.

sentences.zh: 蓋所存者遠，所抑者私也。

translations.literal: Fundamentally what is preserved is distant; what is suppressed is private.
translations.idiomatic: What is kept is the distant public good; what is cut is private feeling.

sentences.zh: 今若外祖及舅更加服一等，堂舅及姨列於服紀之內，則中外之制，相去幾何？

translations.literal: Now if maternal grandfather and uncle add another grade of mourning, hall uncle and aunt are listed within the mourning canon—then how far apart are Chinese and foreign regulations?
translations.idiomatic: If maternal grandfather and uncle gain another grade and hall cousins enter the canon, how far apart would agnate and affine rules be?

sentences.zh: 廢禮徇情，所務者末。

translations.literal: Abandoning ritual and following feeling—what is pursued is the branch.
translations.idiomatic: To abandon ritual for feeling is to chase the branch.

sentences.zh: 古之製作者知人情之易搖，恐失禮之將漸，別其同異，輕重相懸，欲使後來之人，永不相雜。

translations.literal: The ancient fashioners knew human feeling is easy to shake, feared ritual's gradual loss, separated same and different, weight and light hanging apart, wishing later men never to mix.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient makers knew feeling shifts easily, feared ritual would slip, separated kin types and grades so later ages would not mix them.

sentences.zh: 微旨斯在，豈徒然哉！

translations.literal: The subtle intent lies here—how could it be in vain!
translations.idiomatic: The subtle intent is here—not in vain!

sentences.zh: 且五服有上殺之義，必循源本，方及條流。

translations.literal: Moreover the five garments have the meaning of upward reduction; one must follow source and root, then reach the branches.
translations.idiomatic: The five garments also upward-reduce: one must follow the root before the branches.

sentences.zh: 伯叔父母本服大功九月，從父昆弟亦大功九月，並以上出於祖，其服不得過於祖也。

translations.literal: Paternal uncle and aunt in root garment great merit nine months; father's brother's sons also great merit nine months—all above derive from grandfather; their mourning cannot exceed grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Uncles and aunts wear great merit nine months; father's brothers' sons too—both derive from grandfather and cannot exceed him.

sentences.zh: 從祖祖父母、從祖父母、從祖昆弟，皆小功五月；

translations.literal: Second grandfather and grandmother, second grandmother, second grandfather's brothers—all lesser merit five months;
translations.idiomatic: Second grandparents and their brothers: lesser merit five months;

sentences.zh: 以出於曾祖，服不得過於曾祖也。

translations.literal: because they derive from great-grandfather; mourning cannot exceed great-grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: derived from great-grandfather—mourning cannot exceed him.

sentences.zh: 族祖祖父母、族祖父母、族祖昆弟，皆緦麻三月，以其出於高祖，其服不得過於高祖也。

translations.literal: Third grandfather and grandmother, third grandmother, third grandfather's brothers—all finest hemp three months, because they derive from great-great-grandfather; mourning cannot exceed great-great-grandfather.
translations.idiomatic: Third grandparents and their brothers: finest hemp three months from great-great-grandfather—mourning cannot exceed him.

sentences.zh: 堂舅姨既出於外曾祖，若為之制服，則外曾祖父母及外伯叔祖父母，亦宜制服矣。

translations.literal: Hall aunt and uncle already derive from external great-grandfather; if one wears fixed mourning for them, then external great-grandparents and external paternal great-uncles and great-aunts should also wear fixed mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins derive from external great-grandfather; if they wear fixed mourning, so must external great-grandparents and great-uncles.

sentences.zh: 外祖加至大功九月，則外曾祖合至小功，外高祖合至緦麻。

translations.literal: Maternal grandfather increased to great merit nine months—then external great-grandfather should reach lesser merit, external great-great-grandfather finest hemp.
translations.idiomatic: Raise maternal grandfather to great merit, and external great-grandfather becomes lesser merit, external great-great-grandfather finest hemp.

sentences.zh: 若舉此而舍彼，事則不均；

translations.literal: If one cites this and abandons that, the affair is uneven;
translations.idiomatic: Cite one case and drop another and the matter is uneven;

sentences.zh: 棄親而錄疏，理則不順。

translations.literal: abandon intimate and record distant—the principle is not compliant.
translations.idiomatic: abandon the intimate for the distant and principle fails.

sentences.zh: 推而廣之，是與本族無異矣。

translations.literal: Extend and broaden it—this is no different from the root clan.
translations.idiomatic: Push it further and it equals the root clan.

sentences.zh: 服皆有報，則堂外甥、外曾孫、侄女之子，皆須制服矣。

translations.literal: If all mourning has return, then hall sister's son, external great-grandson, and brother's daughter's son—all must wear fixed mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If all mourning reciprocates, hall nephews, external great-grandsons, and a niece's son must all wear mourning.

sentences.zh: 聖人豈薄其骨肉，背其恩愛。

translations.literal: Would the sage be thin toward his flesh and bone, turn his back on his love and affection?
translations.idiomatic: Would the sage slight his flesh and turn from love?

sentences.zh: 情之親者，服制乃輕，蓋本於公者薄於私，存其大者略其細，義有所斷，不得不然。

translations.literal: Where feeling is intimate, mourning is light—fundamentally what roots in the public is thin toward the private; preserve the great and omit the small—righteousness has what it cuts off; one cannot but be so.
translations.idiomatic: Where feeling is intimate, dress is light—public roots thin the private; keep the large, omit the small—righteousness must cut.

sentences.zh: 苟可加也，亦可減也，往聖可得而非，則禮經可得而隳矣。

translations.literal: If it can be added, it can also be reduced; if former sages can be negated, then the ritual classic can be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: What can be added can be reduced; if former sages may be denied, the ritual classic may be ruined.

sentences.zh: 先王之制，謂之彝倫，奉以周旋，猶恐失墜，一紊其敘，庸可止乎？

translations.literal: The former king's regulation is called constant principle; upholding it in turn, one still fears loss—once one confuses its order, how can it be stopped?
translations.idiomatic: The former kings' rule is constant principle; even in upholding it we fear loss—confuse its order and how can it stop?

sentences.zh: 且舊章淪胥，為日已久矣。

translations.literal: Moreover old statutes have sunk and been lost—the days are already long.
translations.idiomatic: Old statutes have long been sinking.

sentences.zh: 所存者無幾，又欲棄之，雖曰未達，不知其可。

translations.literal: What remains is not much; to again wish to abandon it—though called not penetrating, I do not know that it is permissible.
translations.idiomatic: Little remains; to abandon more—though called ignorance, I do not see how it is permissible.

sentences.zh: 請依《儀禮·喪服》為定。

translations.literal: We ask to follow the Mourning Dress in the Ceremonies as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Follow the Ceremonial Mourning Dress as fixed.

sentences.zh: 禮部員外郎楊仲昌議曰：「謹按《儀禮》曰：『外服皆緦。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites Yang Zhongchang deliberated: "Respectfully according to the Ceremonies: 'All external mourning is si.'"
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Yang Zhongchang wrote: "Per the Ceremonies: all external mourning is si hemp."

sentences.zh: 』又曰：『外祖父母以尊加，從母以名加，並為小功五月。

translations.literal: " Again it says: "Maternal grandparents by honored rank increased, mother's sister by name increased—together lesser merit five months."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: maternal grandparents raised by honor, mother's sister by name—together lesser merit five months.

sentences.zh: 』其為舅緦，鄭文貞公魏徵已議同從母例，加至小功五月訖。

translations.literal: " For the uncle finest hemp, Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng already deliberated the same as the mother's sister precedent, increased to lesser merit five months—finished."
translations.idiomatic: For the uncle's finest hemp, Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng already matched the mother's sister at lesser merit five months.

sentences.zh: 今之所加，豈異前旨？

translations.literal: What is now to be added—how does it differ from the former intent?
translations.idiomatic: What is now proposed—how does it differ from that earlier intent?

sentences.zh: 雖文貞賢也，而周、孔聖也，以賢改聖，後學何從？

translations.literal: Though Duke of Literature is worthy, yet Zhou and Confucius are sage—using the worthy to alter the sage, what can later students follow?
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zheng was worthy, but Zhou and Confucius were sages—if the worthy may change the sage, what can later students follow?

sentences.zh: 堂舅姨、堂舅母，並升為袒免，則何以祖述禮經乎？

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters and hall mother's brothers' wives, all raised to tan mian—then how may one trace and transmit the ritual classics?
translations.idiomatic: Cousins on the mother's side and their wives, all raised to tan mian—how then can we claim to follow the ritual canon?

sentences.zh: 如以外祖父母加至大功，則豈無加報於外孫乎？

translations.literal: If for maternal grandparents one increases to da gong, then would there not also be added return mourning for maternal grandsons?
translations.idiomatic: If maternal grandparents are raised to da gong, must not maternal grandsons also return the heavier mourning?

sentences.zh: 如外孫為報，服大功，則本宗庶孫，何同等而相淺乎？

translations.literal: If maternal grandsons in return wore da gong, then the common grandsons of the root lineage—why are they equal in rank yet shallower in mourning?
translations.idiomatic: If maternal grandsons wore da gong in return, how could patrilineal grandsons of the same degree wear less?

sentences.zh: 儻必如是，深所不便。

translations.literal: If it must be so, this is deeply inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: If it must be so, the inconvenience is grave.

sentences.zh: 竊恐內外乖序，親疏奪倫、情之所沿，何所不至，理必然也。

translations.literal: Your servant fears inner and outer will lose their order, near and distant will usurp rank, and where feeling leads—what will not follow? Reason demands it.
translations.idiomatic: I fear inner and outer kin will fall out of order and near and far will invert rank—where feeling leads, what limit will hold? That is inevitable.

sentences.zh: 昔子路有姊之喪而不除，孔子問之，子路對曰：『吾寡兄弟而不忍也。

translations.literal: In antiquity Zilu had mourning for a sister yet did not remove the garments; Confucius questioned him, and Zilu replied: 'I have few brothers and sisters and cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Zilu mourned a sister but would not leave off the garments; Confucius asked him, and Zilu said, 'I have few siblings and cannot bear to do so.

sentences.zh: 』子曰：『先王制禮，行道之人皆不忍也。

translations.literal: ' The Master said: 'When the former kings fashioned rites, even travelers on the road could not bear it.
translations.idiomatic: ' The Master said, 'When the former kings made ritual, even passers-by felt the same reluctance.

sentences.zh: 』子路聞而除之。

translations.literal: ' Zilu heard this and removed the garments.
translations.idiomatic: ' Zilu heard and removed the mourning.

sentences.zh: 此則聖人因言以立訓，援事抑情之明例也。

translations.literal: This is the sage using words to establish instruction—an illuminating example of citing a case to restrain feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Here the sage turned a remark into teaching—an explicit case of using precedent to curb excess of feeling.

sentences.zh: 禮不雲乎，無輕議禮。

translations.literal: Does ritual not say: do not lightly discuss ritual?
translations.idiomatic: Does ritual not say, Do not lightly debate ritual?

sentences.zh: 明共蟠於天地，並彼日月，賢者由之，安敢小有損益也！

translations.literal: Brightness coiled with Heaven and Earth, equal to sun and moon—the worthy follow it; how dare one make small additions or subtractions!
translations.idiomatic: It coils with Heaven and Earth and stands with sun and moon—the worthy follow it; who would dare trim it even slightly!

sentences.zh: 況夫《喪服》之紀，先王大猷，奉以周旋，以匡人道。

translations.literal: How much more the records of Mourning Garments—the great design of the former kings, upheld in practice to rectify the human way.
translations.idiomatic: Above all the Mourning Garments—the former kings' great design, carried in practice to set the human way right.

sentences.zh: 一辭寧措，千載是遵，涉於異端，豈曰弘教。

translations.literal: One word is better left unchanged; for a thousand years it is followed; to touch heterodox paths—how may one call that broadening teaching?
translations.idiomatic: A single phrase is not lightly altered; a thousand years follow it; to wander into side paths is not to enlarge teaching.

sentences.zh: 伏望各依正禮，以厚儒風。

translations.literal: We prostrate ourselves and hope each will follow the correct rites to thicken Confucian custom.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that all adhere to the orthodox rites and strengthen Confucian practice.

sentences.zh: 太常所謂增加，愚見以為不可。

translations.literal: What the Court of Imperial Sacrifices calls increase—in this foolish view cannot be approved.
translations.idiomatic: The increases urged by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices seem to me inadmissible.

sentences.zh: 」又戶部郎中楊伯成、左監門錄事參軍劉秩並同是議，與沔等略同。

translations.literal: " Also Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue Yang Bocheng and Left Gate Recorder Liu Zhi all submitted the same opinion, broadly matching Mian and the others.
translations.idiomatic: " The quote ended. Bureau Director Yang Bocheng in the Ministry of Revenue and Left Gate Recorder Liu Zhi also wrote in the same vein, broadly agreeing with Cui Mian and his allies.

sentences.zh: 議奏，上又手敕侍臣等曰：「朕以為親姨舅既服小功，則舅母於舅有三年之服，服是受我而厚，以服制情，則舅母之服，不得全降於舅也，宜服緦麻。

translations.literal: When the deliberations were memorialized, the emperor again personally edicted the attendant ministers, saying: "Your Majesty holds that for mother's brothers and sisters by blood who already wear xiao gong, the mother's brother's wife wears three years' mourning for the mother's brother; the mourning is receiving me and is thick—by regulating feeling through mourning garments, the mother's brother's wife's mourning cannot be wholly reduced below the mother's brother's; she should wear si hemp.
translations.idiomatic: When the opinions were submitted, the emperor again personally instructed the chief ministers: "I hold that mother's brothers and sisters by blood already wear xiao gong; an aunt by marriage wears three years' mourning for her husband, the uncle—mourning received from me and therefore weighty. By regulating feeling through dress, her mourning cannot be reduced entirely below his; she should wear si hemp.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅古今未制服，朕思惇睦九族，引而親之，宜服袒免。

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters have had no regulated mourning in antiquity and modernity; We contemplate cordial kinship of the nine clans, drawing them near in affection—they should wear tan mian.
translations.idiomatic: Cousins on the mother's side have never had fixed mourning in antiquity or our day; I wish to cherish the nine clans and draw them nearer—they should wear tan mian.

sentences.zh: 又鄭玄注《禮記》雲『同爨緦』，若比堂姨舅於同爨，親則厚矣。

translations.literal: Also Zheng Xuan's commentary on the Book of Rites says 'same hearth si hemp'; if hall mother's brothers and sisters are compared to same hearth, the kinship would be thicker.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan's commentary on the Book of Rites also says 'same hearth, si hemp'; if cousins on the mother's side were classed with same-hearth kin, the bond would be thicker still.

sentences.zh: 又《喪服傳》雲，『外親之服皆緦』，是亦不隔於堂姨舅也。

translations.literal: Also the Mourning Garments Commentary says 'mourning for external kin is all si hemp'—this also does not exclude hall mother's brothers and sisters.
translations.idiomatic: The Mourning Garments Commentary also says, 'All mourning for external kin is si hemp'—that does not exclude cousins on the mother's side either.

sentences.zh: 若以所服不得過本，而須為外曾祖父母及外伯叔祖父母制服，亦何傷乎？

translations.literal: If because the mourning worn cannot exceed the root lineage, one must still wear mourning for external great-grandparents and external uncles and aunts among grandparents—is there any harm?
translations.idiomatic: If the rule is that mourning worn may not exceed that of the root lineage, what harm is there in still mourning external great-grandparents and external uncles and aunts of the grandparent generation?

sentences.zh: 是皆親親敦本之意，卿等更熟詳之。」

translations.literal: These are all the intent of treating kin as kin and thickening the root; you ministers should deliberate further in detail."
translations.idiomatic: All of this serves kinship and thickening the root line; you ministers should deliberate further in detail."

sentences.zh: 侍中裴耀卿、中書令張九齡、禮部尚書李林甫等奏曰：「外族之親，禮無厭降。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-chief Pei Yaoqing, Grand Counselor Zhang Jiuling, Minister of Rites Li Linfu, and others memorialized, saying: "Kin of the external clan—in ritual there is no suppressed demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Attendant Pei Yaoqing, Grand Counselor Zhang Jiuling, Minister of Rites Li Linfu, and others wrote: "External kin are not subject to ritual demotion.

sentences.zh: 外甥既為舅母制服，舅母還合報之。

translations.literal: The sister's son already wears mourning for the mother's brother's wife; the mother's brother's wife in turn ought to return it.
translations.idiomatic: A nephew already mourns his aunt by marriage; she in turn should return the obligation.

sentences.zh: 夫外甥既為報服，則與夫之姨舅，以類是同，外甥之妻，不得無服。

translations.literal: Since the sister's son already wears return mourning, then with the husband's mother's brothers and sisters it is the same by category; the sister's son's wife cannot be without mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If a nephew wears return mourning, the same logic covers the husband's aunts and uncles; a nephew's wife cannot go without dress.

sentences.zh: 所增者頗廣，所引者漸疏。

translations.literal: What is added is rather broad; what is cited grows ever more distant.
translations.idiomatic: What is added grows wide; what is cited grows remote.

sentences.zh: 微臣愚蒙，猶有未達。

translations.literal: This petty official, foolish and ignorant, still has what is not yet understood.
translations.idiomatic: We, dull and ignorant, still do not fully grasp it.

sentences.zh: 」玄宗又手制答曰：「從服有六，此其一也。

translations.literal: " Emperor Xuanzong again personally composed a reply, saying: "Followed mourning has six kinds; this is one of them.
translations.idiomatic: " The quote ended. Xuanzong again drafted a personal reply: "Followed mourning has six kinds; this is one of them.

sentences.zh: 降殺之制，禮無明文。

translations.literal: The regulations for reduction and killing off—in ritual there is no explicit text.
translations.idiomatic: Rules for reducing and stepping down grades have no explicit text in ritual.

sentences.zh: 此皆自身率親，用為制服。

translations.literal: These all take the self as leading kin and use it to fashion mourning garments.
translations.idiomatic: These all take one's own person as leading kin and use that to set mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 所有存抑，儘是推恩。

translations.literal: All preservation and suppression are wholly extending grace.
translations.idiomatic: Every retention or reduction is wholly a matter of extending grace.

sentences.zh: 朕情有未安，故令詳議，非欲苟求變古，以示不同。

translations.literal: We have what is not yet at ease in feeling, therefore ordered detailed deliberation—not wishing casually to seek to alter antiquity to show being different.
translations.idiomatic: I am not yet at ease in my own feeling, hence I ordered further deliberation—not to seek casually to alter antiquity and show myself different.

sentences.zh: 卿等以為『外族之親，禮無厭降，報服之制，所引甚疏』。

translations.literal: You ministers hold that 'kin of the external clan—in ritual there is no suppressed demotion; return mourning's regulation—what is cited is very remote.'
translations.idiomatic: You hold that 'external kin are not subject to ritual demotion' and that 'return mourning, as you cite it, draws on very remote kin.'

sentences.zh: 且姨舅者，屬從之至近也，以親言之，則亦姑伯之匹敵也。

translations.literal: Moreover mother's brothers and sisters are kin of the collateral at the utmost nearness; speaking by closeness, they are also the match of father's sisters and father's brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover aunts and uncles are collateral kin of the utmost nearness; by closeness they match father's sisters and father's brothers.

sentences.zh: 豈有所引者疏，而降所親者服？

translations.literal: How can what is cited be remote, yet the mourning for those who are kin be reduced?
translations.idiomatic: How can what you cite be remote while the mourning worn for those who are close be reduced?

sentences.zh: 又婦，從夫者也。

translations.literal: Moreover the wife follows the husband.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover a wife follows her husband.

sentences.zh: 夫之姨舅，夫既有服，從夫而服，由是睦親。

translations.literal: The husband's mother's brothers and sisters—the husband already has mourning; following the husband in mourning—thereby cordial kinship.
translations.idiomatic: For the husband's aunts and uncles, the husband already has mourning; following the husband in mourning is how kinship is kept warm.

sentences.zh: 實欲令不肖者企及，賢者俯就。

translations.literal: Truly wishing to make the unworthy aspire and the worthy bend down to approach.
translations.idiomatic: The aim is truly to let the unworthy aspire and the worthy bend down to approach.

sentences.zh: 卿等宜熟詳之。

translations.literal: You ministers should deliberate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: You ministers should deliberate further in detail.

sentences.zh: 」耀卿等奏曰：「陛下體至仁之德，廣推恩之道，將弘引進，以示睦親，再發德音，更令詳議。

translations.literal: " Yaoqing and others memorialized, saying: "Your Majesty embodies utmost benevolent virtue and broadly extends the way of grace, intending to enlarge kinship and display cordial kin relations, again issuing virtuous words and further ordering detailed deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " The quote ended. Yaoqing and others wrote: "Your Majesty embodies utmost benevolence and extends grace broadly, seeking to widen kinship and show familial warmth, and has again ordered further deliberation.

sentences.zh: 臣等按《大唐新禮》：親舅加至小功，與從母同服。

translations.literal: Your servants examine the New Tang Rites: the mother's brother increased to xiao gong, the same mourning as the mother's sister.
translations.idiomatic: We have reviewed the New Tang Rites: a mother's brother was raised to xiao gong, matching the mother's sister.

sentences.zh: 此蓋當時特命，不以輕重遞增，蓋不欲參於本宗，慎於變禮者也。

translations.literal: This was at that time a special command, not increasing grade by grade, broadly not wishing to mix with the root lineage—caution in altering ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That was a special order of the time, not a ladder of ever-heavier grades—chiefly to keep external kin from merging with the main line, a cautious change of ritual.

sentences.zh: 今聖制親姨舅小功，更制舅母緦麻，堂姨舅袒免等服，取類《新禮》，垂示將來，通於物情，自我作則。

translations.literal: Now the sage regulation makes mother's brothers and sisters xiao gong, further regulating the mother's brother's wife as si hemp, hall mother's brothers and sisters as tan mian, and the like—taking categories from the New Rites, displaying them for the future, penetrating common feeling, making the rule oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty sets mother's brothers and sisters at xiao gong, an aunt by marriage at si hemp, and cousins on the mother's side at tan mian—following the New Rites as a type, showing the future a rule that fits human feeling and is made here and now.

sentences.zh: 群儒風議，徒有稽留。

translations.literal: The multitude of Confucians in discussion merely had delay.
translations.idiomatic: The Confucian debaters had only delayed.

sentences.zh: 並望准制施行。

translations.literal: All hope to approve the regulation and put it into practice.
translations.idiomatic: All ask that the regulation be approved and enforced.

sentences.zh: 」制從之。

translations.literal: " The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The quote ended. The regulation was approved.

sentences.zh: 天寶六載正月，出嫁母宜終服三年。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year of Tianbao, a mother who has married out her son should complete the three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: First month, Tianbao 6: a married-out mother should observe the full three-year mourning.
